# LLM surface list — athenaeum#1731, migrated to symbols by athenaeum#2224
#
# One ENTRY per line, relative to the repo root. Blank lines and lines
# starting with `#` are ignored (a `#` must start the line — there are no
# trailing comments). Three forms, all legal:
#
#   src/athenaeum/prompts/                     prefix: every path under it
#   src/athenaeum/context.py                   one whole file
#   src/athenaeum/tiers.py::tier3_merge        one symbol inside a file
#
# A symbol is a top-level `def`/`class`, a `Class.method`, or a module-level
# assignment target (a constant). The ONE parser is
# `check_llm_surface_receipt.parse_surface_entry`; the rot check imports it
# rather than re-implementing it.
#
# This is the ONE file both `scripts/check_llm_surface_receipt.py` (the
# `.github/workflows/eval-receipt-check.yml` gate) and
# `tests/test_llm_surface.py` (the rot check) read.
#
# WHAT THE GATE DOES WITH IT (athenaeum#2223): for each entry it compares a
# docstring-stripped AST fingerprint at the merge base and at the head, over
# the UNION of the designations at both ends. So a comment, a docstring or a
# reformat inside a designated symbol costs nothing, an edit to an
# UNDESIGNATED function in the same file costs nothing, and deleting an entry
# cannot hide a change to the symbol it named. Design of record:
# `docs/design/eval-trigger-surface.md`.
#
# WHY IT IS SYMBOL-LEVEL (athenaeum#2224): `config.py` (8k lines),
# `librarian.py` (12k) and `tiers.py` (9k) used to be listed whole, so 68 of
# the 141 PRs merged in the 30 days to 2026-10-30 tripped the gate and 66 of
# those passed on free-text "not needed". An exemption that is the default
# answer is an exemption nobody reads.
#
# TWO PROVENANCES, both legitimate:
#
#   MACHINE-DERIVED — `tests/test_llm_surface.py` fails CI if any member of a
#   derived set is missing from this file (D1-D5 of the design's §5.2). The
#   derived blocks below are written out rather than computed at read time,
#   because the gate must work from `git show` with no install; re-derive them
#   by running that test's `model_call_sites` / `prompt_constant_entries` /
#   `routing_seam_entries` helpers.
#
#   HAND-CURATED — response parsers, request builders and gating thresholds
#   that no pattern finds (R3/R4/R5 of the design's §3). No test requires
#   these, and each carries its own one-line reason below. Designation is NOT
#   transitive: an edit to an undesignated helper that a designated symbol
#   calls does not fire. That is an accepted limit (§5.2) — the backstops are
#   D1 (moving logic OUT of a call site changes the call site), review, and
#   curating a helper once it has been missed.
#
# Every check is a SUBSET check, never equality and never a count, so a
# hand-curated entry is always legal and removing one never fails CI.

# --- hand-curated: R3/R4 — reasoning entry points that take an `LLMBackend` and call through the
# protocol rather than the SDK, so D1's `.messages.create` scan cannot see
# them. Re-derive the candidate list with: every top-level function or method
# in src/athenaeum/**.py with a parameter annotated `LLMBackend`. ---
# free-text answers are resolved by a model call made through the backend

src/athenaeum/decay_bucket.py::stamp_decay_bucket

# without touching a prompt or a call site. ---

# parses the merge-ops response
src/athenaeum/tiers.py::parse_merge_ops_response

# --- Whole-file entries, deliberately. These are small enough, or uniform
# enough, that symbol granularity would buy nothing. ---
# every `.md` file here is loaded as a live system prompt by tiers.py (machine-enforced: a new file in this directory is exactly as much a prompt edit as a PROMPT_META row)
src/athenaeum/prompts/
# the sidecar delivery path: this shell hook is what a recall actually reaches the model through
examples/claude-code/user-prompt-recall.sh
# the sidecar context builder — the whole module is prompt assembly
src/athenaeum/context.py
# the sidecar block renderer — likewise
src/athenaeum/sidecar_blocks.py
# an LLMBackend importer with no direct call site and no backend-taking entry point; listed whole until its reasoning symbols are curated (D4 floor)
src/athenaeum/decay_sweep.py

# `docs/design/prompts.md` was listed here until athenaeum#2224. It is
# GENERATED from the registry and byte-pinned by
# `tests/test_prompt_goldens.py`, so designating it made the gate fire on
# a file no human edits and no eval reads. The prompts themselves are
# designated by D2 above.
